fields.transport: Verilator-only vlogdefine BASE_ISA (BaseIsa PR macro unused)

configuration_equivalence.supported_configuration: small only; fixed Verilator BASE_ISA define; other configurations not validated

comparison.note: FST byte equality is observed only, not a required portability guarantee

trace_audit.retirement_semantics: RVFI-valid architectural retirement/event stream; not merely an encoding observation. Trap-marked records require separate interpretation.
trace_audit.producer: rtl/ibex_core.sv:1890-1902 no-writeback output stage follows ID/EX completion (retirement); trap tracking also present
trace_audit.register_limit: Printed x0=0 does not represent a mutable x0 write; per-event operands/writeback do not constitute full GPR state.
trace_audit.pcount_window: 477 cycles / 261 retired apply to hello output measurement window; firmware disables pcount before timer loop; not total trace count

verilator.reason: Relocate upstream installed prefix without /tools or system modification

libelf.method: apt-get download (no installation) and dpkg-deb -x into dedicated external directory

setup_interventions.reason: relocated Verilator root lacked launcher/bin relative link
setup_interventions.resolution: two relative symlinks under extracted tool prefix; retry exit 0

setup_interventions.reason: identical trace content hashes initially produced duplicate artifact IDs; CaseBundle correctly rejected them before pair creation
setup_interventions.resolution: use distinct run reference IDs, retain identical content hashes; no experiment rerun
